_comment: Shared expectations for Arabic text normalization used by ORDER SEARCH. The TypeScript (lib/order-filter-utils.ts normalizeArabicText) and the SQL (public.normalize_arabic_text_for_search) must BOTH satisfy every case. NOTE: lib/address-validator.ts has a DIFFERENT normalizeArabicText that folds Kurdish/Farsi ی ک ە and collapses whitespace but does not fold ى. That divergence is real (1,647 live names contain ى) and deliberately NOT reconciled here — these cases pin the search variant only.

cases.why: alef madda folds to plain alef
alef maqsura folds to ya - 1,647 live rows
Arabic-Indic digits survive: they sit immediately after the diacritic range and a sloppy character class eats them
